corridors.newcomer_tip: Majestic is Bengaluru's main transit hub. The Kempegowda Metro Station entrance is on the east side of the bus stand.
corridors.peak_warning: Purple Line metro is very crowded 8–10 AM and 6–9 PM on weekdays. Board from the first coach to avoid crowds.

steps.instruction: Walk east ~400 m to Kempegowda Metro Station entrance.
Board Purple Line (Challaghatta–Whitefield) towards Whitefield/Kadugodi — it is the last stop.
Exit and walk ~300 m to Whitefield Main Road.
Walk east ~400 m to Kempegowda Metro Station entrance.
Board Purple Line towards Whitefield/Kadugodi — fastest option on this corridor.
Exit and walk ~300 m to Whitefield Main Road.

corridors.newcomer_tip: BMTC buses 500C/500D depart from Silk Board junction frequently. The bus stop is on the flyover service road — ask anyone for 'Silk Board BMTC stop'.
corridors.peak_warning: Silk Board junction is one of the worst traffic bottlenecks in Bengaluru. Avoid 8–10 AM and 6–9 PM if possible.

steps.instruction: Walk to the BMTC stop near Silk Board flyover service road.
Board BMTC 500C or 500D towards Electronic City. Tell the conductor 'Electronic City'.
Hire an auto at Silk Board. Insist on meter or negotiate ₹130–170. Off-peak journey is around 20 minutes.

corridors.newcomer_tip: Vayu Vajra AC buses depart from the Arrival Level (ground floor) — look for orange 'Vayu Vajra' signage. Buy ticket from the conductor on board.
corridors.peak_warning: NH 44 from the airport can be heavily congested during peak hours. The Vayu Vajra bus uses a dedicated lane but Hebbal flyover may still cause delays.

steps.instruction: Exit arrivals and look for orange 'Vayu Vajra' BMTC signage on the ground floor.
Board Vayu Vajra KIA-9 via Hebbal, Mekhri Circle, Cauvery Bhavan to MG Road.
Walk ~200 m to MG Road Metro Station if needed.

fastest.label: Vayu Vajra Bus KIA-9 (same route — fastest option available)

steps.instruction: Exit arrivals and find the orange Vayu Vajra bus bay on the ground floor.
Board KIA-9 express — off-peak it takes about 55 minutes. Best value and most reliable public transit from the airport.
Walk ~200 m to MG Road Metro Station.

corridors.newcomer_tip: BMTC Volvo buses from Majestic are air-conditioned and comfortable. Buy your ticket from the conductor after boarding.
corridors.peak_warning: Avoid this route by road between 8–10 AM and 6–9 PM. Electronic City Flyway reduces congestion significantly but traffic near Silk Board remains heavy.

steps.instruction: Head to Platform 17 at Kempegowda Bus Stand (KBS) — look for Volvo AC bus signs.
Board BMTC 500A Volvo AC bus. It goes via Jayanagar, Silk Board flyway, Electronic City Flyway directly to EC Phase 1.
Head to Platform 17 for Volvo AC buses.
Board BMTC 500A — alight at Electronic City Flyover (earlier stop, saves ~5 min).
Take a quick auto to your exact destination in EC Phase 1 or Phase 2.

corridors.newcomer_tip: There is no direct metro between Indiranagar and Koramangala. The easiest way is BMTC bus 335E or an auto. Auto meters start at ₹30 for the first 2 km.
corridors.peak_warning: The Old Airport Road and 100 Feet Road stretch can be very slow during evenings. Consider the bus for predictable timing.

steps.instruction: Walk to the BMTC bus stop on 100 Feet Road near CMH Road junction.
Board BMTC 335E towards Koramangala. Tell conductor 'Koramangala 5th Block'.
Hire an auto from Indiranagar 100 Feet Road. Insist on meter — typical fare is ₹100–140 to Koramangala.

corridors.newcomer_tip: Marathahalli is a key IT corridor stop. BMTC buses are frequent from Whitefield station. The bridge area has many app cab and auto options.
corridors.peak_warning: Outer Ring Road near Marathahalli is one of the most congested stretches in Bengaluru — avoid 8–10 AM and 6–9 PM.

steps.instruction: Exit metro and walk ~200 m to the BMTC stop just outside the station.
Board BMTC 335 towards Marathahalli. Alight at Marathahalli Bridge — a prominent landmark.
Take an auto from Whitefield station. Ask for 'Marathahalli Bridge'. Typical meter fare is ₹110–150.

corridors.newcomer_tip: Yeshwanthpur is on the Green Line (North–South). Just two stops south brings you to Majestic. Very quick and cheap.
corridors.peak_warning: Green Line metro can be crowded on weekday mornings. Trains run every 5–8 minutes during peak hours.

steps.instruction: Walk to Yeshwanthpur Metro Station — it is adjacent to the railway station.
Board Green Line (Madavara–Silk Institute) towards Silk Institute (southbound). Alight at Kempegowda station — 2 stops.
Exit metro and walk ~400 m west to reach Kempegowda Bus Stand (Majestic).

fastest.label: Green Line Metro (same — metro is fastest)

steps.instruction: Walk to Yeshwanthpur Metro Station next to the railway station.
Board Green Line southbound. Kempegowda/Majestic is just 2 stops away.
Walk ~400 m to reach Kempegowda Bus Stand.

corridors.newcomer_tip: Jayanagar metro station is on the Yellow Line (RV Road–Bommasandra). Change at MG Road station onto Purple Line if you need to go further east.
corridors.peak_warning: MG Road metro station can be very crowded on weekday evenings. Use the second exit near Brigade Road for quicker access.

steps.instruction: Walk to Jayanagar Metro Station on 11th Main Road.
Board Yellow Line (RV Road–Bommasandra) northbound towards RV Road/Trinity. Alight at Trinity station.
Exit Trinity station and walk ~600 m to MG Road. MG Road Metro Station is also one stop further on the Purple Line.
Take an auto from Jayanagar. Ask for 'MG Road Brigade Road end'. Typical meter fare ₹90–130. Off-peak takes around 20 minutes.
